structure: Single high school course (header u1: 'Grade/Course: Asian Studies / ACCN: CHR2100'). Each page is a series of small tables: a Strand/Standard table (Strand: Asian Studies; 'Standard N: ...'), then one table per benchmark with Topic, benchmark text (split across rows) and code (Benchmark SS.AS.n.m), then 'Sample Performance' (example task), 'Assessment (SPA)' and a 4-level Rubric (Advanced/Proficient/Partially Proficient/Novice, columns C1-C4) restating the benchmark. Page breaks split some rubric rows.
issues: Rubric rows (Advanced/Proficient/Partially Proficient/Novice) and 'Assessment (SPA)' labels labeled backup as assessment material; 'Sample Performance' tasks labeled examples.
u56-u63, u115-u118, u171-u174, u225-u228: rubric sentences split across page breaks, all backup.
Course has no stated grade; assigned 9-12.
